description: $0.02 USDC on Solana per call — One $0.02 call returns one tenor's dated yield series over the requested start/end range within the snapshot range 1990-01-02–2026-10-09; dates on which the tenor was not published are returned with a null yield and are never interpolated. Data vintage: a fixed historical snapshot of the Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates — business days 1990-01-02 through 2026-10-09, collected October 2026 from the official U.S. Department of the Treasury feed (fiscaldata.treasury.gov / home.treasury.gov), whose terms offer the data free, without restriction, for commercial redistribution. Dates after 2026-10-09 are not covered by this snapshot.

limit.description: Max rows (the LAST limit matching rows); default 365, clamped 1-3650.
